title: 第17章 有能耐你进来啊第18章 久远的记忆在攻击我
slug: 师门不要我反手建个更强的
content_zh:
云星落贴着隐身符站在附近，她本来不想现身的，但是雷霆竟然把她的隐身符给烧了，让她现出真身来。
突然出现的身影，把南宫倩和叶凌霜都愣了一下，两人双双出声，“原来是你！”
“嗨，大家好呀！”
云星落挥了挥手。
南宫倩面色一冷，厉声道，“云星落，是不是你撬动石笋，把雷霆放出来的？”
云星落讪讪一笑，“怪我咯，我又不是故意的。”
“你害得那么多人被雷霆击伤，你真该死。”
叶凌霜咬牙切齿。
“你害得我们拿不到渡劫神莲，云星落，你这个贱人。”
南宫倩恨意冲天。
云星落淡淡一笑，“刚才谁说的圣物有德者居之，我又没阻止你们取渡劫神莲，是雷霆伤的你们，又不是我，你们何必生气？”
南宫倩冷哼，“伶牙俐齿的，大家别跟她掰扯，我们联手先杀了她，再想办法怎么封印这雷劫。”
叶凌霜抬眸，发现对面的云星落站在雷霆中，似乎不受任何影响，反而很享受的样子。
她看不出端倪，但直觉告诉她，只要有云星落在，他们就拿不到圣药。
叶凌霜点点头，“也好！”
两人忍着被雷霆缠绕的痛苦，挥剑向云星落袭来。
面对两名金丹巅峰高手的联手，云星落不慌不忙。
诚如叶凌霜所想，她因为灵根是变异雷灵根，丝毫不受这些雷霆的影响，反而极为舒服。
云星落缓缓伸出手，抓住了几条正在飞舞的金色雷龙，运转功法疯狂压缩，把它们压缩成一个雷球，向着南宫倩和叶凌霜扔了过去。
“轰隆！”

雷球在两人之间炸开，恐怖的能量以两人为中心向四周疯狂扩散，强大的冲击力把两人冲撞到周边的石笋上。
石笋瞬间碎裂，两人都跌落在地。
“噗嗤！”
两人都被轰得口吐鲜血。
此时的两人极为狼狈，南宫倩距离最近，头发被轰炸得焦黑，冒着呲呲的白烟。
叶凌霜内力深厚，但身上也是伤痕遍布。
周边，金色的电弧依然疯狂缠绕着她们，云星落的一击让她们几乎灵力耗尽，根本没有办法应付这些电弧。
“先出去，再不出去就死翘翘了。”
叶凌霜果断转身，向着溶洞外面奔去。
南宫倩挣扎了一下，怨毒了看了云星落一眼，也奔出了山洞。
所有人都出了溶洞，里面只剩下云星落了。
很好，她可以安静地采摘圣药了。
然而就在云星落的手触碰到渡劫神莲的时候，它竟然拔地而起，跑了。
“圣药会跑？”
云星落目瞪口呆，还真是闻所未闻啊！
这时，识海之中，传来图图稚嫩的声音。
“小主，渡劫神莲生长环境特殊，需要在雷霆丰富之地，你就这样把它拔走，它当然不愿意。”
“原来如此！”
云星落怔住，“那怎么办？”
“先收服这朵九玄金雷，有了适合它的环境，还怕它不来。”
content_en:
Yun Xingluo was standing nearby with her invisibility talisman. She didn't want to reveal herself, but Lei Lei burned her invisibility talisman and made her reveal her true body.
The sudden appearance of the figure stunned Nangong Qian and Ye Lingshuang for a moment, and they both said, "So it's you!"
"Hi, everyone!"
Yun Xingluo waved his hand.
Nangong Qian's face turned cold and she said sternly, "Yun Xingluo, was it you who pried the stalagmites to release the thunder?"
Yun Xingluo smiled and said, "You blame me, I didn't mean it."
"You deserve to die for causing so many people to be struck by lightning."
Ye Lingshuang gritted her teeth.
"You made it impossible for us to get the Divine Tribulation Lotus, Yun Xingluo, you bitch."
Nangong Qian was filled with hatred.
Yun Xingluo smiled faintly, "Who said just now that holy objects can only be kept by virtuous people? I didn't stop you from taking the Divine Tribulation Lotus. It was you who were injured by the thunder, not me, so why should you be angry?"
Nangong Qian snorted, "Smarty, don't argue with her. Let's join forces to kill her first, and then figure out how to seal this thunder disaster."
Ye Lingshuang raised her eyes and found Yun Xingluo standing opposite the thunder, seemingly unaffected by the thunder and actually enjoying it.
She couldn't see the clues, but her intuition told her that as long as the cloud stars fell, they would not be able to get the holy medicine.
Ye Lingshuang nodded, "That's fine!"
The two of them endured the pain of being entangled by thunder and struck at Yun Xingluo with their swords.
Facing the cooperation of two peak Jindan masters, Yun Xingluo remained calm and unhurried.
Just as Ye Lingshuang thought, because her spiritual root was a mutated thunder spirit root, she was not affected by these thunders at all and felt extremely comfortable.
Yun Xingluo slowly stretched out his hand, grabbed several flying golden thunder dragons, and compressed them crazily with his running skills, compressing them into a thunder ball and throwing them towards Nangong Qian and Ye Lingshuang.
"Boom!"
The thunderball exploded between the two people, and the terrifying energy spread wildly around the two people. The powerful impact knocked the two people into the surrounding stalagmites.
The stalagmite shattered instantly and both of them fell to the ground.
"Pfft!"
Both of them were beaten to the point of vomiting blood.
At this time, the two of them were in an extremely embarrassed state. Nangong Qian was the closest, her hair was burnt black by the bomb, and she was smoking white smoke.
Ye Lingshuang has deep internal strength, but her body is also covered in scars.
Surrounding them, golden arcs of electricity were still wrapping around them crazily. Yun Xingluo's blow almost exhausted their spiritual power, and they had no way to deal with these arcs.
"Get out first, or you'll die if you don't."
Ye Lingshuang turned around decisively and ran towards the outside of the cave.
Nangong Qian struggled for a while, glanced at Yun Xingluo resentfully, and ran out of the cave.
Everyone came out of the cave, leaving only Yunxingluo inside.
Great, she can pick the elixir in peace.
However, just when Yun Xingluo's hand touched the Tribulation Divine Lotus, it rose up from the ground and ran away.
"Can the holy medicine escape?"
Yun Xingluo was stunned, this was really unheard of!
At this time, Tutu's childish voice came from the sea of ​​consciousness.
"My little master, the Tribulation-Ending Divine Lotus has a special growth environment and needs to be in a land rich in thunder. If you just pull it out like this, of course it won't want to."
"That's it!"
Yun Xingluo was stunned, "What should we do?"
"Control this Nine-Xuan Golden Thunder first. Now that we have a suitable environment for it, we are still afraid that it won't come."
